verifications.note: china5e.com / 江西日报, 2016-09-21: '9月20日,...省天然气管网工程井冈山支线...正式开工建设' — construction of the Jinggangshan Branch (whole 3-segment group incl. this mainline) began Sept 20 2016, exact year+month match. verified live via url_verifier for '203公里'/'5.2亿元' substrings on the same page.

resolutions.researcher_notes: Found via own search (not a wiki candidate) — 江西日报 groundbreaking report for '省天然气管网工程井冈山支线', the combined mainline+Anfu+Lianhua branch project. A shared groundbreaking date is reasonably attributable to this segment even though the article's quantity figures (length/capacity/cost) are project-aggregate and are NOT staged here — see the __VALIDITY__ record below. Single host (china5e); no second independent outlet found for this specific construction date within budget.

The only candidate (wiki-attributed, china5e/news-960906) reports 3.15亿立方米(=0.315 bcm/y) as the TOTAL capacity of the whole 3-segment Jinggangshan Branch project (mainline+Anfu+Lianhua, 203km combined), not this 129km mainline sub-segment alone. GEM's 0.32 is suspiciously close to that project-total 0.315 (not an exact segment-level figure) — see __VALIDITY__. Declined to stage per the aggregate-vs-segment rule. No segment-specific capacity source found; jxgajc.com (another wiki candidate host for this row) has its port shut (confirmed per BRIEF's measured host conditions), so not reachable this pass.

Wiki candidate jxgajc.com/Hr/show-7403.aspx (129 km, exact match) is unreachable — port shut per BRIEF's measured conditions; confirmed again this pass. Tried Wayback availability API as a fallback (archive.org/wayback/available?url=jxgajc.com/Hr/show-7403.aspx) — got HTTP 429 (rate-limited, matches BRIEF's 'degraded today' note), so existence could not even be checked; did not fan out further per the serial-only guidance. china5e/news-960906 gives only the 203km 3-segment aggregate (does not match 129km) — see __VALIDITY__. Genuinely open; worth a retry on jxgajc.com or Wayback in a later pass.

Same single candidate (jxgajc.com/Hr/show-7403.aspx) as Length — inaccessible (port shut, confirmed again this pass; Wayback availability API also 429'd). No alternate source located for this specific segment's diameter within budget.

resolutions.researcher_notes: No document found naming the specific upstream trunk lines feeding the Jinggangshan Branch's Jiangxi provincial network tie-in. The china5e groundbreaking article describes only route/scope, not gas-source attribution. Not pursued further to conserve WebSearch budget shared across the fan-out.

china5e/news-960906 confirms the branch runs through the general Ji'an prefecture area toward Jinggangshan but is not precise about 吉州区 (Jizhou District, GEM's StartLocation) vs. the separate, similarly-named 吉安县 (Ji'an County) — a genuine Chinese administrative-geography ambiguity the article doesn't resolve. Left UNRESOLVED rather than risk pairing a ref with an unconfirmed district-level claim; flagging the Jizhou-vs-Ji'an-County distinction for a future pass with more budget.

china5e/news-960906 (the wiki's own candidate for this cell) states total investment for the WHOLE 3-segment Jinggangshan Branch project (mainline+Anfu+Lianhua, 203km) as 5.2亿元 = 520,000,000 RMB — an EXACT match to GEM's existing SegmentCost value. That is strong evidence GEM's own SegmentCost was entered as the project aggregate rather than a mainline-only figure; see __VALIDITY__ below. Declined to stage as a confirming ref for that reason — pasting it back would cement, not correct, the mismatch. No segment-only cost breakout was found.

P4789 ('Jinggangshan Branch' mainline, 129.00 km / 0.32 bcm/y / SegmentCost 520,000,000 RMB) is one of three sub-segments of a single combined project reported by 江西日报/china5e (2016-09-21, news-960906): '省天然气管网工程井冈山支线' = mainline + Anfu branch + Lianhua branch, TOTAL 203 km / 3.15亿立方米 (0.315 bcm/y) / 5.2亿元 (520,000,000 RMB total investment), groundbreaking 2016-09-20. P4789's own Capacity (0.32, ~matches the 0.315 aggregate) and SegmentCost (520,000,000.00, EXACT match to the aggregate) look like the project-total figures were entered onto this one 129km sub-segment's cells rather than a mainline-specific figure — a probable aggregate-vs-segment data issue, not a new finding I'm asserting as fact. Recommend a human check whether GEM tracks the Anfu and Lianhua branches as separate rows (prior_findings notes this row's name cell 'holds a chopped fragment of one multi-segment string (with P4788)' — consistent with this project having been split awkwardly across rows). I could not check P4788/other sibling rows for this exact possibility within my own shard (batch_08 contains only P4789/P4649/P4657) — per the fan-out rule, this should be cross-checked against whichever shard covers P4788 and any other Jinggangshan/Anfu/Lianhua rows before any row is retired or re-scoped. Not recommending any row deletion — flagging for adjudication only. Length (129.00, does not match 203) and Diameter are unaffected by this aggregate/segment concern; they are UNRESOLVED for the separate reason that their only candidate host (jxgajc.com) is unreachable this pass (port shut; Wayback 429'd).
